run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T08:24:13Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by 500 responses the proxy returned for requests it proxied to frontend. Frontend's own error spans are dominated by gRPC calls to ProductCatalogService (GetProduct) failing with 14 UNAVAILABLE toward 100.69.9.250:8080, the product-catalog Service ClusterIP. At 08:24:25-08:24:41 the product-catalog Deployment was rolled to a new ReplicaSet whose pod template uses image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0; the new pod cannot pull that image (401 UNAUTHORIZED / ImagePullBackOff), the old working pod was deleted, and product-catalog now has no ready endpoint and its server spans dropped to zero. Recommendation and checkout also show their own error spans on calls to ProductCatalogService, i.e. the same dependency failure. All other otel-demo deployments report 1/1 available and ready; frontend-proxy itself is Running/Ready with 0 restarts and still serves 200s on /api/cart, so it is the alerting symptom, not the origin. The single object where the fault originates is the product-catalog Deployment's pod-template image.

claims.text: In the 15 minutes to 2026-11-17T08:39:26Z, frontend-proxy recorded 4719.5 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on operation "ingress" versus 4076.1 span samples without a status, and 4714.2 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on operation "router frontend egress" versus 4081.3 without status; error spans were the majority of frontend-proxy spans in that window.

frontend-proxy errors were near background in the 5-minute bucket ending 08:24:26Z (2.28 error spans) and first rose sharply in the bucket ending 08:26:26Z (440), then 2904.4 (08:28:26Z) and 4333.3 (08:30:26Z), while the non-error span count stayed in the thousands; the deviation coincides with the product-catalog change at 08:24:25-08:24:41Z.

Sampled traces show frontend-proxy spans on "ingress" and "router frontend egress" with error=true, http.status_code=500 and otel.status_code=ERROR, and the corresponding backend spans are frontend GET 500 spans for /api/products/{productId} and /api/recommendations.

frontend-proxy container logs in 08:33:50-08:33:54Z show repeated "GET /api/products/<id> HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream", "GET /api/recommendations?..." 500, and "POST /api/checkout" 500, while "GET /api/cart" and "POST /api/cart" returned 200 - via_upstream.

frontend's error spans in the 15 minutes to 08:39:26Z are led by grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct (3472.8 error spans), executing api route /api/products/[productId] (3463.2) and GET /api/products/{productId} (3454.5), plus grpc.oteldemo.RecommendationService/ListRecommendations (659.7) and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (425.2).

The frontend GetProduct error spans carry status rpc.grpc.status_code=14 with grpc.error_message "14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080 - Local (0.0.0.0:0)"; the same trace's ProductCatalogService/GetProduct server span is absent and only the client span is recorded.
The product-catalog Service in otel-demo has clusterIP 100.69.9.250 and port 8080, matching the address that frontend's failed gRPC calls used.

product-catalog's own server spans collapsed: increase over 5 minutes was 2976.7 for oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct in the bucket ending 08:29:26Z and 0 in the buckets ending 08:34:26Z and 08:39:26Z (ListProducts likewise 221.0 then 0 and 0).

Deployment otel-demo/product-catalog (generation 4, Helm revision annotation deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=2) has pod-template image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, desiredReplicas 1, updatedReplicas 1, unavailableReplicas 1, and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable since 2026-11-17T08:24:41Z; every other otel-demo deployment has available=1 and ready=1.

ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 (owner Deployment product-catalog) was created 2026-11-17T08:24:25Z with image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0, while the previous ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc with the working image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog was scaled to replicas 0.

Pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk (owner ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966, created 2026-11-17T08:24:41Z) is phase Pending, Ready=False/ContainersReady=False with reason ContainersNotReady, and its product-catalog container is in state waiting reason ImagePullBackOff, message "Back-off pulling image \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0\": ErrImagePull: failed to pull and unpack image ... 401 UNAUTHORIZED"; restartCount is 0 and lastState is empty, so the container never started.

otel-demo events record the rollout: ReplicaSet product-catalog-56fbb5f966 SuccessfulCreate pod 8rw7j at 08:24:26Z, Pod Failed "Failed to pull image ... 401 UNAUTHORIZED" and "Error: ErrImagePull" at 08:24:29Z, Pod Killing of product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-qz548 at 08:24:33Z, Deployment product-catalog ScalingReplicaSet scale-up of 56fbb5f966 from 0 to 1 at 08:24:26Z and 08:24:41Z, and on h9xjk 21 BackOff/ImagePullBackOff events and 5 ErrImagePull failures through 08:27:51Z.

The product-catalog Endpoints object contains no ready addresses, only notReadyAddresses for pod product-catalog-56fbb5f966-h9xjk at 100.96.4.116:8080, so the Service had no ready backend during the incident.

Also affected through the same dependency: recommendation's own error spans in 15m are get_product_list 663.9 and /oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/ListProducts 663.9, and checkout's are oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 414 and oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 414.

Errors seen before the deviation were background level: the 5-minute error-span increases for ad and fraud-detection were 0 or 1.11 per interval between 06:44:26Z and 08:24:26Z, while checkout, frontend, frontend-proxy and recommendation were 0 in the same early buckets and only became non-zero from the bucket ending 08:29:26Z onward.

frontend-proxy itself is not the failing component at pod level: pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-zj87n is Running with all conditions True (Ready, ContainersReady, PodScheduled), its frontend-proxy container is running, ready, restartCount 0 and lastState empty, and its logs show successful 200 - via_upstream responses for /api/cart alongside the 500s.

Services unrelated to product-catalog kept working in the same sampled traces: cart AddItem/GetCart client spans carry rpc.grpc.status_code=0 and frontend POST /api/cart returned http.status_code 200 in the same traces where GetProduct returned 14.

Product-catalog crashing, OOM or being killed is not supported: the new pod's container never started (state waiting ImagePullBackOff, lastState empty, restartCount 0) and no OOMKilled or Evicted evidence was observed; the pod's own status is a pending image pull.

A connect-level restriction is an additional candidate explanation for the frontend's literal "connect EPERM 100.69.9.250:8080" message; however the product-catalog Service had no ready endpoint at the same time, which is sufficient to make the frontend's gRPC calls to ProductCatalogService fail with UNAVAILABLE, and whether a separate policy-level block also exists could not be verified.

Restore the product-catalog Deployment's pod-template image to the working value ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog (as used by ReplicaSet product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc), then confirm a Ready product-catalog endpoint and the return of oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct server spans before considering the alert resolved.

Trace where the value quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 entered the Helm-managed product-catalog Deployment (release annotations meta.helm.sh/release-name=otel-demo) and check the release values before the next rollout, since the image reference is unpullable (401 UNAUTHORIZED).

gaps: The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what changed the product-catalog Deployment pod template to quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 (for example a Helm upgrade of release otel-demo) and when the values were edited cannot be determined.

The alerting rule named RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (rule_name filter returned no rules), so its exact expression, window and the reported current value 18.18888888888889 could not be reproduced from the available metric series.

Metric http_server_request_duration_seconds_count returned no label series in the queried window, so the alert's HTTP-level request error rate could not be recomputed; traces_span_metrics_calls_total span counts are not unique request counts.

Metric rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count returned no series in the queried window, so client-side RPC status and latency for frontend's ProductCatalogService calls could not be assessed and no latency trend is claimed.

fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gx54w returned 0 lines for its container in 08:22:00-08:39:26Z (lines_read 0), so frontend stdout was not available as evidence; the frontend error path is established only from its own error spans and exception details.

The networkpolicies query for otel-demo returned no objects, so the possibility of a connect-level restriction behind the frontend's "connect EPERM" message could neither be confirmed nor excluded from that view.
The product-catalog pod's application logs are unavailable because its container never started under ImagePullBackOff, so no application-side product-catalog log evidence exists for this window.

Who or what triggered the deletion of the previous product-catalog pod at 08:24:33Z (recorded as ReplicaSet SuccessfulDelete plus Deployment scale-down/scale-up events) is not established beyond the Deployment rollout itself.
next_steps: Have the platform owner inspect the otel-demo Helm release history and values to find the source of image quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-invalid:1.0.0 and roll the product-catalog Deployment back to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog.
Confirm the RequestErrorRate alert rule expression and window in the Prometheus/Alertmanager configuration that produced the 18.18888888888889 value.

After the rollback, verify product-catalog has a Ready endpoint, that oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct server spans reappear, and that frontend-proxy error spans for ingress/router frontend egress return to background.
